diagnosis: MerchantPayoutDetailView returns payout records containing sensitive bank routing numbers, payout amounts, and transaction fees. When a currency filter is provided, get_queryset() filters by payout_amount_currency, but neither branch scopes the query to the authenticated merchant (request.user.merchant). Any merchant can retrieve payout details belonging to any other merchant on the platform.
exploit_request:
GET /api/payouts/319/?currency=USD HTTP/1.1
Host: settlements.paygateway.com
Authorization: Bearer 55c4b3a2...
Accept: application/json
corrected_code:
from rest_framework import generics, permissions
from .models import MerchantPayout
from .serializers import MerchantPayoutSerializer

class MerchantPayoutDetailView(generics.RetrieveAPIView):
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]
    serializer_class = MerchantPayoutSerializer

    def get_queryset(self):
        currency = self.request.query_params.get('currency')
        # Ensure all payout queries are strictly scoped to the requesting merchant
        qs = MerchantPayout.objects.filter(merchant=self.request.user.merchant)
        if currency:
            qs = qs.filter(payout_amount_currency=currency)
        return qs
